# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues or Discussions.

If private vulnerability reporting is enabled for this repository, use the **Report a vulnerability** option on the repository's Security page. Otherwise, contact the repository maintainers privately through GitHub and include enough information to reproduce and assess the issue.

Do not include real credentials, private keys, EAB values, or other secrets in a report. Use sanitized examples.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are generally made to the latest published version. Include the affected version, environment details, and a concise impact description in a report.
